name: Anonymous share viewer
summary: What happens when someone opens a share link: which links resolve, and the anonymous identity Track3D gives the viewer so the shared view can load without an account.

roles.note: The anonymous share viewer is not a product role. The content of that record was not read.

actions.note: Anyone with the link; no sign-in

actions.action: Act in the project as the anonymous share viewer
actions.note: Decided by the anonymous role record (DEC-047)

nfr.statement: Time from opening a share link to the shared view being shown.
nfr.open_question: How fast must a shared view open for an outside viewer on a typical connection?

requirements.title: Only an active link to a live project opens, as an anonymous viewer
requirements.statement: Opening a share link needs no sign-in. It resolves only if the link is active and not deleted and its project exists and isn't deleted. The viewer gets the link's saved view and a token for the shared anonymous account that carries the share key. This viewer is not an invited project user.

acceptance_criteria.given: An active link to a live project
acceptance_criteria.when: Someone opens it without signing in
acceptance_criteria.then: They get the saved view and an anonymous token carrying the share key

requirements.title: Outside stakeholders see a shared view without an account
requirements.statement: A share link gives an outside stakeholder controlled, view-only access to the project view it was made for, replacing less secure sharing such as email attachments. Links are protected in transit.
